lineage.transformation_summary: Native task-led example with a reusable method skill and a reproducible ResearchOS read adapter; the host retains execution and admission authority.

task_contract.user_job: Compare user-selected research methods under one explicit question and evidence boundary.
inputs: Two or more user-selected papers or cards
One explicit decision or comparison question
invariants: User-selected materials remain the source authority
Durable writeback remains a Review candidate until human confirmation
confirmation_gates: Confirm the comparison question before analysis
Confirm before durable writeback or public reuse
completion_criteria: All methods are compared under explicit shared dimensions
Each judgment traces to evidence or is marked unresolved
The result mode, validation limit, and next action are reported
failure_modes: The selected methods are not comparable under the proposed dimensions
recovery: Request the missing question or source
Return unresolved differences instead of forcing a ranking
task_contract.retention_rule: Retain the task-led extension only if its bounded workflow is more reliable than an unconstrained current-model answer.

admission.retirement_condition: Retire when it no longer demonstrates the smallest safe installable task-extension pattern.

authority.source: User-selected papers or cards remain the evidence source.
authority.candidate: The comparison is a candidate judgment until reviewed.
authority.confirmation: Human confirmation is required before durable writeback or public reuse.
authority.save_target: Use the existing answer, artifact, or Review flow; this extension owns no storage.

en.name: Compare research methods
en.goal: Compare selected methods under an explicit research question and evidence boundary.
en.user_input_hint: Provide two or more paper/card paths and the decision the comparison should support.
en.output: Comparison dimensions + evidence-bounded judgment + unresolved differences + next action
next_steps: Attach the smallest relevant source set

zh-CN.name: 研究方法对比
zh-CN.goal: 围绕一个明确研究问题，在证据边界内比较用户选定的方法。
zh-CN.user_input_hint: 提供至少两个论文或卡片路径，并说明这次比较要支持什么判断。
zh-CN.output: 比较维度 + 有证据边界的判断 + 未解决差异 + 下一步
next_steps: 选择直接回答、生成文件或候选写回
